description: On the bed in front of you there’s a small stack of brightly colored plastic plates near the right side. The right hand reaches in, touches the top green plate, lifts it off the stack and sets it down to the right, then lifts the yellow plate and places it to the left, and finally separates the blue and red plates so the red ends up on top while the blue is moved down and away; the right-hand object changes from green to yellow to blue and then red as each plate is picked up and released.
